output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: cosmo
params:
  analysis_dir: "results/r_analysis"   # output dir of R/process_pilot.R
date: "`r format(Sys.Date())`"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat); library(data.table); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork); library(DT)
})
ad <- params$analysis_dir
seu <- readRDS(file.path(ad, "seurat_object.rds"))
comp <- fread(file.path(ad, "cell_composition.csv"))
qc_pre  <- fread(file.path(ad, "qc_summary_prefilter.csv"))
qc_post <- fread(file.path(ad, "qc_summary_postfilter.csv"))
iso_path <- file.path(ad, "isoform_table.csv")
has_iso <- file.exists(iso_path)
```

## Overview

Placental long-read single-cell RNA-seq pilot (10x GEM-X 3' v4 → PromethION),
quantified against the **HPLRv2.1** placental transcriptome reference. Cell
composition is assessed with **SingleR** against the integrated placenta atlas.

## QC

```{r qc-table}
knitr::kable(rbind(cbind(stage = "pre-filter", qc_pre),
                   cbind(stage = "post-filter", qc_post)),
             caption = "Cell / gene / UMI / mitochondrial QC summary")
```

```{r qc-violins, fig.height=4}
VlnPlot(seu, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3, pt.size = 0)
```

```{r qc-scatter}
FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt") +
  FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
```

## Cell composition

```{r umap}
DimPlot(seu, group.by = "singleR_label", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE) + NoLegend()
```

```{r composition}
ggplot(comp, aes(x = reorder(singleR_label, fraction), y = fraction, fill = singleR_label)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) + coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction of cells", title = "Cell-type composition (SingleR)") +
  theme_minimal()
datatable(comp, options = list(pageLength = 15))
```

## Isoform exploration (long-read)

```{r isoform, eval=has_iso}
iso <- fread(iso_path)
cat("Transcripts quantified:", nrow(iso),
    "\nPlacental (HPLRT_) isoforms:", sum(iso$is_novel_HPLRT, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
top <- head(iso[order(-total_counts)], 25)
ggplot(top, aes(x = reorder(gene_name, total_counts), y = total_counts,
                fill = is_novel_HPLRT)) +
  geom_col() + coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Total counts", title = "Top transcripts", fill = "HPLRT isoform") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r isoform-flags, eval=has_iso}
if (all(c("EAS_term", "EUR_preterm", "EUR_term") %in% names(iso))) {
  flag_counts <- data.table(
    population = c("EAS_term", "EUR_preterm", "EUR_term"),
    transcripts = c(sum(iso$EAS_term == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE),
                    sum(iso$EUR_preterm == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE),
                    sum(iso$EUR_term == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE)))
  ggplot(flag_counts, aes(population, transcripts, fill = population)) +
    geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(title = "Detected transcripts by population flag", y = "Transcripts", x = NULL) +
    theme_minimal()
}
```
